note: Logistic maps the S9 ranking score through a near-identity sigmoid (intercept -4.6, coef 9.2 so 0.50→0.50 and 0.95→0.94). Isotonic then mildly down-weights the 0.20–0.40 band, which observed 0% accuracy on 5 cells. A full PAV fit on 418 cells pools 0.40–1.00 into a single 0.855 bin and would flag every cell; that collapse is overfitting, not calibration, and is not shipped. Silent errors at 0.95 have no feature that identifies them. See LIMITATIONS.md §2.
